title: Determination of florfenicol and florfenicol amine in fish plasma through HPLC MS/MS
author: Betty San Martín
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zhdf326
materials: Synergi TM 4 µm fusion RP 80Â 50 x 2.0 mm analytic column
Analyst 1.6.3 and Multiquant 3.0 software was used for equipment management and integration, respectively.

steps.title: Add water and acetone
steps.instruction: Place 250 µL of each plasma sample into a 15 mL Falcon tube, then add 500 µL water and 2 mL acetone.

steps.title: First extraction mixing
steps.instruction: Shake the tube for 10 minutes, sonicate for 10 minutes, then centrifuge at 5 000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer to dichloromethane and repeat mixing
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 15 mL Falcon tube containing 2 mL dichloromethane (Bio Basic Inc., Catalog #DC3600.SIZE.1L), shake for 10 minutes, sonicate for 10 minutes, and centrifuge at 5 000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Phase separation and evaporation
steps.instruction: Discard the upper water phase, then evaporate the remaining organic phase at 40 °C–50 °C under a nitrogen stream until completely dry.

steps.title: Reconstitution and final clarification
steps.instruction: Reconstitute the dry residue with 1 mL mobile phase and 1 mL hexane, shake, sonicate, and centrifuge at 5 000 rpm (duration as previously used).

steps.title: Transfer aliquot for injection
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of the lower (organic) phase to an autosampler vial for HPLC‑MS/MS injection.

steps.title: Instrument setup and run conditions
steps.instruction: Configure the LC‑MS/MS system: use an Agilent 1290 Infinity series LC coupled to an ABSCIEX API 5500 triple‑quadrupole MS; install a Synergi™ 4 µm Fusion RP 80 Å, 50 × 2.0 mm analytical column; prepare mobile phase A (0.1 % acetoacetic acid in water) and mobile phase B (0.1 % acetoacetic acid in water/methanol 1:9); set flow to 350 µL min⁻¹; apply a gradient from 32 % to 68 % solvent A over 3 minutes (as described: “gradient elution from 32 % up to 68 % solvent A in 00:03:00 of 35 % phase solvent A, and 75 % phase solvent B”); set column oven to 37 °C; inject 2 µL of sample.
